Moving

Select your hero, then choose a destination.

Move, run or sneak using the movement control. Select portraits to change the active character.

Controls depend on your keyboard, gamepad and camera settings. The in-game guide shows your current bindings.

Classic edition reference

These original pages describe classic mouse and keyboard controls. Use the guidance above for current settings and gamepad controls.

Tutorial (gameplay)

Welcome to Evil Islands!

This is the tutorial system. It will appear on the screen from time to time during the 'introductory' quest.

Some of the longer tutorials will include several screens. To move from screen to screen, use the buttons at the bottom. Please be sure to read the tutorials carefully. A great deal of very useful information is in the tutorials.

Keep in mind that while the tutorials are up on the screen, gameplay is "paused".

Most screen elements (such as menus, icons, etc) have pop-up tips. Placing the cursor over an element for a few seconds will cause the tip will appear.

To see the last tutorial screen again, just press the <H> key.

Note: the controls described here are default controls. If you change your default settings, some descriptions may no longer be accurate.

Tutorial (interface)

Each interface screen has its own tutorials. If you wish to display the screen's tutorial press the <H> key.

Controls (character)

Your character is now in a Game zone. If you want him to walk somewhere just click on the point and he will go there. If you double-click on the point, he will run there.

Note: your character cannot always travel through all parts of the Game zone. If you try sending him to a point he can't reach he'll either go to the nearest accessible point or simply remain where he was.
